sql.userPosition.getAll: select distinct upv.user_position_id as id, upv.primary_flag, upv.start_date, upv.end_date, upv.position, upv.position_id, upv.company_id, uphv.hierarchy from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.user_position_hierarchy_vw uphv on uphv.user_id = upv.user_id and uphv.org_id = upv.org_id and uphv.position_id = upv.position_id where upv.company_id = :companyId and upv.user_id = :userId order by upv.start_date desc
